title: Mail list search does not group name and subject before section and publication filters
evidence_state: Actual mail model and Joomla 5.4.6 locked database query builder exercised with isolated dependencies; SQL execution and Joomla UI unverified
source_references: component/admin/src/Model/MailsModel.php:58-79; Joomla 5.4.6 composer.lock pins joomla/database 3.4.3; its DatabaseQuery::where and QueryElement::__toString concatenate predicates without grouping
code_excerpt: The search OR expression is passed without parentheses before additional AND filters.
problem: A name match can bypass section and publication filters due to SQL operator precedence.
expected: Apply section and publication filters to matches in either name or subject.
actual: The actual model and Joomla database 3.4.3 query builder generated unparenthesized name LIKE OR subject LIKE AND section AND published predicates with isolated database and model dependencies.
customer_impact: Administrators can see matching names outside their selected section or publication state and may act on unexpected list results.
proposed_fix: Group the name and subject search conditions before adding section and publication predicates.
regression_risks: Preserve searches with no filters, subject matches, sorting and pagination.
automated_tests: Exercise name-only and subject-only matches with each filter separately and together including nonmatching states and sections.
manual_tests: On an authorized isolated Joomla shop use disposable mail templates and compare search results with section and publication filters.
joomla_5_6: Joomla 5.4.6 database builder source exercised in isolation; full Joomla 5 and Joomla 6 UI and database unverified.

title: Inline product-price discount editing fails shopper-group validation
evidence_state: Actual product and order discount table validation exercised with isolated parent stubs; Joomla administration unverified
code_excerpt: Inline submitted fields omit shopper group but both table checks require shopperGroups option.
